product_name: Wobble One 5G (8GB+128GB) | 50MP Epic Front Camera | Dual 4K HDR | Dolby Vision AMOLED | Zero Bloatware Android 15 | Sony LYTIA 600 OIS | Dimensity 7400 | Eclipse Black
description: SEGMENT'S ONLY 50MP FRONT CAMERA — 4K HDR. NOW THAT'S EPIC — While others max out at 16MP or basic 1080p front video, the Wobble One shoots 4K in HDR from the front — yes, the front. The 50MP Creator's Eye camera brings Wide Angle, Dual Camera Mode, Facial Tracking, Ultra Video Stabilisation, and Super Night Shot. Your content just levelled up. Epically. EPIC REAR CAMERA — 50MP SONY LYTIA 600 + OIS + 4K HDR — This isn't just a camera — it's an epic creative weapon. The Sony LYTIA 600 sensor with OIS captures 4K HDR video and stills that belong on a big screen. RAW shooting, Super Night Shot, Portrait Aberration Correction, Video Portrait Bokeh, Super Video Stabilisation, AI Best Shot — plus an 8MP Ultra wide-angle and 2MP macro for every angle your story demands. EPIC VISUALS — SEGMENT'S ONLY DOLBY VISION 6.7" 120Hz AMOLED — Seeing is believing — and seeing on the Wobble One is epic. The FHD+ AMOLED display runs at a buttery 120Hz with 240Hz touch response, and as the only phone in its segment with Dolby Vision, every frame pops exactly as the creator intended. Add dual Dolby Atmos stereo speakers and you have an immersive experience no competitor in the segment can match. EPIC PERFORMANCE — 4NM DIMENSITY 7400 5G, THE CHIP THAT NEVER BLINKS — Built on 4nm class architecture with an AnTuTu score of 1,040,000, the Dimensity 7400 5G is engineered for creators who can't afford lag. HyperEngine Gaming keeps frame rates locked under load. NPU 655 accelerates AI tasks by up to 25% faster than the previous generation. UFS 3.1 + LPDDR5 memory ensures lightning-fast reads and writes. And with 25% greater power efficiency plus cryogenic-class thermal engineering, it stays cool while you stay epic. EPIC DESIGN — FROSTED GLASS, ALUMINIUM FRAME, 7.8MM SLIM PROFILE — Epic performance deserves an epic body. The Wobble One wears a premium frosted glass back, a special aluminium alloy frame, and a head-turning flagship camera module — all at a jaw-dropping 7.8mm slim. Available in three epic colourways: Mythic White, Eclipse Black, and Nova Blue. This isn't just a phone — it's a statement.
